lines.text: Cut Thoughtstone. Under the Red Span. Prime stuff. Sells itself.
...I will not dig it. A grave is a grave. But if somebody did...
The yard treats that place as a grave.
I know. I know. That is why my hands are clean. Strike the claim, buy at a fair price, or take it to the Undermarket. Three roads, friend.
He wants us to dig it up.
